=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:532-537 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new plan-granted `.github/ai/<file>` block runs a bare `git add -- "${github_ai_grant_path}"` with no ignore check. It then logs `outcome=staged` unconditionally. The script runs under `set -euo pipefail` (line 9).
  WHY: A granted path ignored by `.gitignore` or `core.excludesFile` makes `git add` exit non-zero, so `set -e` aborts the whole implement commit step and no `IMPLEMENT_GITHUB_AI_GRANT outcome=` token is logged. The self-repo block (line 482, `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`) and scripts/review_commit_changes.sh (line 529) both pre-check the path. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:803-830 (also 873-878; scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4634, 4659-4666) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `extract_failing_tests` silently caps `files` at `FAILING_TEST_LIMIT = 20`, and `triage_target_files_guard` also stops at 20 (`[ "${#guard_paths[@]}" -lt 20 ] || break`). Neither layer signals truncation, and the guard treats the list as the complete set of failing files.
  WHY: When more than 20 files fail, the first 20 can be absent on the PR head while a later file exists there. The guard then clears ROUTING_TARGET_BRANCH and sends the fix to the default branch (the wrong branch). Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 2); the other four rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:2494-2508 (triage_base_gate_check 1796-1966; also 1795-1796, 1839, 1858, 1865-1870) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After the target-files guard clears the PR-branch route (`BASE_GATE_TARGET_ROUTE_DEFERRED="true"`), the base-gate recheck compares against `BASE_REF` (the PR's original base). It should compare against `ROUTING_DEFAULT_BRANCH`, the branch the fallback issue now targets.
  WHY: For a PR based on a non-default branch, a green run on that base can log `skip reason=pr_specific_failure`, so no issue is filed while the default branch is red. The reverse case files a default-branch issue for a failure that exists only on the PR's base. Reviewers that flagged it rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this claim: the existing default-route gate already compares against BASE_REF, so it called this matching behaviour rather than a regression.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:164-243 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `allowed` / `_parse_granted_paths` admit plan-granted `.github/ai/*` paths only from the `<manifest>.github_ai_grants.json` sidecar written by `snapshot`. A missing, partial or malformed sidecar silently yields an empty grant (`frozenset()`).
  WHY: If `snapshot` fails, `transfer` / `refresh` (and the heal `cmd_scope` mirror at scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh lines 644-670) reject every granted file as out-of-scope, with no log line separating "configured" from "missing". Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR; minimax_minimax-m3 rated it NIT.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:803-817 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: This is a verification record of the trusted-helper invocation in triage_target_files_guard (credentials stripped, `timeout 60`, `python3 -I -B`, output checked with jq, hostile paths rejected at 823-824). The reviewer states "No finding."
  WHY: The reviewer recorded it only because the trust-boundary lens applies to this changed surface (severity NIT). The lens result is NONE.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:plan-granted .github/ai block, lines 532-537 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new block stages any granted regular file with a bare "git add" and does not check whether the path is ignored. The self-repo block (line 482) and scripts/review_commit_changes.sh both pre-check with "git ls-files --others --exclude-standard".
  WHY: An ignored granted path makes "git add" exit 1, and set -e (line 9) aborts the commit step with no IMPLEMENT_GITHUB_AI_GRANT outcome token, which breaks the outcome=staged|absent|refused contract. Fix: run "git check-ignore -q" first and log outcome=refused (about 2 lines).
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh (triage_target_files_guard 20-cap loop, guard_on_target decision); scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py FAILING_TEST_LIMIT = 20 (line 4634), cap at line 4659, merged cap at line 10957 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The helper silently caps "files" at 20 with no truncation mark, and the guard treats those 20 as the complete set.
  WHY: With more than 20 failing files, where the first 20 are absent on the head but a later file exists there, the guard routes the fix to the default branch. The ordering needed is specific, so the impact is narrow. Fix: keep the route (reason=files_truncated) when the helper returns exactly FAILING_TEST_LIMIT files.
- Note (not reported): the reviewer rejected the claim that the base-gate recheck should use ROUTING_DEFAULT_BRANCH instead of BASE_REF, because the existing default-route gate already compares against BASE_REF and this is not a regression.
